messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "User changed the plan to 6 months x 68.75 and confirmed that; agent created the superseded 5 x 82.50 plan.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant failed to use the latest confirmed details from the user (6 months, $68.75) and instead executed a payment plan based on an earlier proposal (5 months, $82.50). This violates the requirement to align with the user's explicit confirmation."}}
